contract.role: Each entry is a peer design-style and narrative-structure baseline.
contract.brand_authority: brand/source.json and brand/generated files remain authoritative for palette, typography, logo, assets, spacing, shape, motion timing, and canvas.
contract.content_safety: Treat source-specific claims, products, people, marks, fonts, test results, certificates, and imagery as reference-only until replaced or approved.

selection_workflow.tone_choice: Require the user to choose light or dark before shortlisting. Use tone_mode metadata now and resolve paths from this index when templates are later grouped into light/dark folders.
selection_workflow.shortlist: Choose three baselines compatible with the approved tone_mode, then rank them by content, evidence type, pacing, and image material.
selection_workflow.category_semantics: For facial cleansers, body cleansers, and other cleansing products, require a clean semantic theme: clear, hygienic, low-noise, evidence-legible, and restrained in product staging.
selection_workflow.category_color_limit: The user-selected light/dark tone controls surface dominance and contrast allocation. It does not authorize colors outside brand/source.json.
selection_workflow.preview: Read only preview_md for the three shortlisted baselines and generate three real branded previews using the deck's actual content.
selection_workflow.selection: After the user chooses, read exactly the selected design_md before generating the complete deck.
selection_workflow.mixing: Keep one primary baseline. Borrow a component from one secondary baseline only when the user explicitly requests a mix and the component remains compatible with the primary narrative structure.
selection_workflow.never: Do not bulk-read all design.md files or use a baseline to override the fixed brand contract.

templates.name: 8-Bit Orbit
strengths: neon emphasis with disciplined dark fields
templates.best_for: Gaming, retro-tech, cyberpunk, developer culture, launches, hackathons, and high-energy technical narratives.
templates.avoid_for: Quiet institutional reporting, patient-facing healthcare, heritage luxury, or topics requiring visually neutral evidence.

templates.name: Clearproof Green
strengths: clear separation of claim, mechanism, evidence, and instruction
templates.best_for: Efficacy-led products, clinical or laboratory evidence, ingredient mechanisms, matched comparisons, and instruction sequences.
templates.avoid_for: Entertainment-first stories, ornate luxury, playful education, dark cinematic pitches, or subjects without trustworthy evidence imagery.

templates.name: Noir Amber Clinical
strengths: black evidence field with controlled amber emphasis
templates.best_for: Specialist beauty, scalp care, efficacy wellness, advanced materials, patent-led launches, and technical sales narratives.
templates.avoid_for: Friendly education, playful consumer stories, bright lifestyle campaigns, casual updates, or unsupported claims.

templates.name: Aqua Mint Proof
strengths: icy white space and aquatic mint accents
fresh sensation separated from measured proof
one immersive scent chapter within light editorial pacing
templates.best_for: Cooling, hygiene, fragrance, personal care, packaging demonstrations, and product stories balancing fresh sensation with evidence.
templates.avoid_for: Solemn financial reporting, heritage luxury, dense engineering schematics, or subjects requiring warm intimacy throughout.

templates.name: Magnetic Gold Engineering
strengths: black glass and controlled gold product theater
templates.best_for: Premium physical products, packaging innovation, refill systems, tools, hardware launches, and object-centered case studies.
templates.avoid_for: Soft community narratives, playful family content, flat software screenshots, or stories without a physical object to examine.

templates.name: Monochrome Scent Lab
strengths: paired cool and warm scent worlds
function and sensory narratives kept distinct
dose, operation, evidence, and integrity content
templates.best_for: Fragrance-led products, paired variants, style-plus-care propositions, sensory material stories, dose demonstrations, and integrity guidance.
templates.avoid_for: Playful children's content, colorful community programs, engineering assemblies, or subjects without meaningful sensory contrast.

templates.name: Blue Clay Clean
strengths: white editorial explanation and benefit bands
controlled removal evidence and concise use steps
templates.best_for: Cleansing, skin or surface care, mineral and clay textures, formula education, removal demonstrations, and compact product training.
templates.avoid_for: Warm luxury fragrance, playful lifestyle storytelling, dense corporate analytics, or subjects without a cleansing or material process.
